hooks.name: week-data-validation
hooks.description: Validate week data files after creation/edit

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Extract week number from path
echo "Validating week data..."
# Note: Full validation happens at commit time via pre-commit hook

hooks.matcher: tool == 'Write' && (file_path matches 'src/modules/.*\\.(js|jsx)' || file_path matches 'src/components/.*\\.(js|jsx)' || file_path matches 'src/services/.*\\.(js|jsx)')
hooks.name: app-code-validation

hooks.matcher: tool == 'Write' && (file_path matches '.*master.*prompt.*\\.txt' || file_path matches 'Production_FINAL/.*\\.md' || file_path matches '.*\\.yaml' || file_path matches '.*\\.json')
hooks.name: prompt-template-validation

hooks.matcher: tool == 'Write' && (file_path matches '.*secret.*' || file_path matches '.*\\.env' || file_path matches '.*api.*key.*' || content matches 'sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}' || content matches 'AIza[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{35,}')
hooks.name: secret-detection

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
echo "⚠️ POTENTIAL SECRET DETECTED in $file_path"
echo "Do NOT commit API keys or secrets to git!"
echo "Use environment variables instead."

engquest-preflight.description: Run pre-flight system check before production

engquest-bug-check.description: Run bug prevention checks for a week

engquest-quality.description: Run quality gate for a week

engquest-e2e.description: Run E2E tests for a week

engquest-validate-all.description: Run all validations for a week
engquest-validate-all.command: bash tools/preflight_check.sh && bash tools/bug_prevention_check.sh ${week} && bash tools/code_quality_gate.sh ${week}
